demos.name: Diagram Studio
demos.description: Pick or edit a flow diagram stored as data: move boxes, Simulate the arrows, change the speed, Reset, undo, tidy, present, embed, and export as JSON, SVG, PNG or one offline HTML file.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm start (port 6001). Or: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:6001 only). Replace __CHECKOUT__ in composeFile with this checkout's absolute path before adding the entry to the shelf (the shelf requires an absolute path).
